title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
author: Ken Kesey
summary: Con man Randle McMurphy fakes madness to avoid a prison work farm and finds himself on a psychiatric ward run by the cold, controlling Nurse Ratched. The story is narrated by Chief Bromden, a silent patient.
readIf: you like a classic about institutions, authority and one person's defiance.
skipIf: you are bothered by outdated attitudes to mental illness, race and women, which show up in the book.

pairings.reason: Another satire of a rigid institution where logic is turned against the people in it.
A woman's account of depression and psychiatric treatment in the same era.
A thriller set in a mental hospital where nothing is quite as it appears.
